title: 90-degree sweeper grip versus drift comparison
description: 90-degree turn, 120 m centerline radius, 12 m width, 30 m/s entry, 50 m approach and exit from BENCHMARKS.md 'Handling fixtures' (Sweeper row). Paired scripted grip and drift controllers receive the same entry conditions. The initial tuning aim is a clean drift within 5% of the effective grip line's elapsed time; that is a documented target, not a measurement.

segments.note: Approach straight from the BENCHMARKS sweeper row.
Arc length r*theta = 188.4956 m. Turn direction is an authored initial value; BENCHMARKS does not fix left or right.
Exit straight from the BENCHMARKS sweeper row.

comparison.purpose: Compare the scripted drift line against the matched grip line for the three starters at stock and maximum upgrades.

metrics.name: drift_vs_grip_elapsed_time_ratio
metrics.description: Initial sweeper target: a clean drift within 5% of the effective grip line's elapsed time (BENCHMARKS). A single sweeper cannot establish whole-game parity.

metrics.description: Record surge-on/off exit speed at 0.5/1/2 seconds and elapsed time over the next 100 m (BENCHMARKS). Recording requirement; no threshold is claimed.

metrics.description: M1 compares the 0.5/1/1.5 m/s candidates from GAME_DESIGN and retains the smallest useful result that preserves grip competitiveness. No candidate is validated here.
